caption: Featuring smooth, expressive male lead vocals sung in Hindi, this contemporary Bollywood romantic song exudes a sweet, affectionate mood. The musical arrangement is driven by a relaxed, mid-tempo groove with clean electronic beats and claps, rounded out by subtle plucked strings, deep basslines, and airy synth pads. The polished production highlights the vocal's melodic charm, creating an uplifting and tender pop atmosphere.
